hindi: वास्तु के विवाद सामन्त के आधार वाले हैं।
english: Disputes about a site have the neighbours (sāmanta) as their basis.
notes: Nominal sentence; the copula is supplied. sāmanta is rendered 'neighbours' here (adjoining holders); the glossary's 'neighbouring chief' belongs to Books 9 and the like. pratyaya: basis, trust, ground; the exact sense (evidence, authority) is not settled. Hindi सामन्त is kept as printed.

hindi: घर, खेत, उद्यान, सेतु-बन्ध, तालाब अथवा आधार वास्तु है।
english: A house, a field, a garden, a setu-bandha (embankment-dam), a tank, or a receptacle (ādhāra) is a site (vāstu).
notes: ādhāra is rendered literally 'receptacle'; 'reservoir' is the usual sense in the context of taṭāka, but that is not stated. In Hindi आधार reads as 'support' and is kept only as the literal word. setu-bandha could also be read as a dvandva 'embankment and dam'. vāstu gender taken as masculine from the ending -uḥ.
lines_deva: गृहं क्षेत्रम् आरामः सेतु.बन्धस् तटाकम् आधारो वा वास्तुः
lines_iast: gṛhaṃ kṣetram ārāmaḥ setu.bandhas taṭākam ādhāro vā vāstuḥ

hindi: प्रत्येक घर पर सेतु कर्ण-कील-आयस का जोड़ है।
english: At each house, the setu [is] the joining of karṇa, peg and iron-made [parts].
notes: Obscure. karṇa is literally 'ear' (perhaps a projecting piece or tenon, not stated); āyasa 'made of iron'. setu is left as 'setu' because here it is not clearly the embankment of unit 2; it may be a connecting structure between houses. The compound may be a dvandva of three items governed by sambandha, or sambandha may be 'connection by' them. Low confidence; no sense is asserted.

words.gloss: according to use of the setu

hindi: सेतु के उपभोग के अनुसार घर बनवाए।
english: [One] should have a house made according to the use of the setu.
notes: Subject not stated; 'one' is supplied. bhoga: use, enjoyment (rendered 'use' throughout this chunk).

hindi: अथवा जो हुआ नहीं है, उसमें दूसरे की दीवार से दो अरत्नि या तीन पद हटकर देश-बन्ध बनवाए।
english: Or, [in the case of] what has not [yet] come into being, having moved away from another's wall by two aratnis or by three steps, [one] should have a deśa-bandha (literally 'place-binding') made.
notes: abhūtam is taken literally as 'not come into being' (possibly 'a new construction' or 'not existing' on the spot); the grammatical function is unclear. deśa-bandha is rendered literally; its exact sense (a demarcated plot or space) is not settled. tripadī: a distance of three steps. aratni stays aratni (glossary).
lines_deva: अभूतं वा पर.कुड्याद् अपक्रम्य द्वाव् अरत्नी त्रिपदीं वा देश.बन्धं कारयेत्
lines_iast: abhūtaṃ vā para.kuḍyād apakramya dvāv aratnī tripadīṃ vā deśa.bandhaṃ kārayet

words.gloss: what is fit for a house
pit of a woman in childbed

words.gram: m. abl. sg. with ā (up to)

hindi: “अवस्कर, भ्रम अथवा कुआँ — घर के योग्य को छोड़कर नहीं; सूतिका के कूप को छोड़कर, दसवें दिन तक।”
english: “Refuse, a bhrama or a well — not, except what is fit for a house; except a childbed-woman's pit, up to the tenth day.”

text_flags.why: iti closes a quoted rule but nothing in the unit opens the quotation or names the speaker; no change proposed (possible)

notes: The closing iti is carried by the quotation marks only; there is no opening quote in the unit, the quoted rule is the whole unit. Predicate not stated (left open with a dash). bhrama is obscure: kept as printed, no sense asserted. ā-nirdaśa-ahāt: 'up to the tenth day' (ā with the ablative; whether the tenth day is included is not settled). kūpa could be 'pit' or 'well'; 'pit' chosen beside udapāna 'well'. sūtikā: a woman who has given birth. TEXT FLAG NEEDED (hand edit): closing 'iti' with no opening quotation or introducing verb in this unit. The opening quotation mark in the Hindi and English is added by the translator; the unit itself is taken as the quoted rule. Whether the rule begins in an earlier unit is not settled.
lines_deva: अवस्करं भ्रमम् उद.पानं वा न गृह.उचिताद् अन्यत्र, अन्यत्र सूतिका.कूपाद् आ.निर्दश.अहाद् इति
lines_iast: avaskaraṃ bhramam uda.pānaṃ vā na gṛha.ucitād anyatra, anyatra sūtikā.kūpād ā.nirdaśa.ahād iti

hindi: उसका अतिक्रमण होने पर प्रथम साहस-दण्ड है।
english: In transgression of that, [there is] the first fine for rashness.
notes: Copula supplied. daṇḍa with a paṇa figure is rendered 'penalty', as in Book 4; sāhasa-daṇḍa stays 'fine for rashness' (glossary). 'Transgression of that' refers back to the rule of unit 6 (or the setu rules).

hindi: इससे ईंधन-कुटाई से किया हुआ तथा शुभ कार्यों में आचाम-जल के मार्गों की व्याख्या की गई।
english: By that, what is done with fuel and pounding, and the rinsing-water channels in auspicious acts, are explained.

text_flags.why: possible: compound members indhana and avaghātana are joined without the compound dot and with a+a=ā left unresolved, unlike the rest of the edition

notes: Formula 'tena X vyākhyātam'. indhana-avaghātana-kṛta is obscure: literally 'done/made with fuel(-)pounding'; it may be a dvandva of fuel and pounding plus kṛta, or 'a made place for fuel-pounding'. ācāma is rendered 'rinsing' (sipping of water); gloss uncertain. kalyāṇa-kṛtya: literally auspicious acts (rites). 'By that' points back to an earlier rule on water discharge (not in this unit). The plural vyākhyātāḥ agrees with the nearest subject mārgāḥ.

hindi: तीन पद या डेढ़ अरत्नि पीछे हटा हुआ, गहरा फैला जलमार्ग अथवा प्रस्रवण-प्रपात बनवाए।
english: Receded by three steps or by one and a half aratnis, [one] should have made a deeply extended water-channel or a prasravaṇa-prapāta (flowing fall).
notes: The grouping 'receded by three steps or one and a half aratnis' is taken to qualify the water-channel or fall; the syntax is loose. gāḍha-prasṛta: gāḍha 'deep, firm, dense'; prasṛta 'extended, spread'; alternative 'firmly spread'. prasravaṇa-prapāta is rendered literally ('flowing', 'fall'); it may be a spout or cascade, not stated.
lines_deva: त्रिपदी.प्रतिक्रान्तम् अध्यर्धम् अरत्निं वा गाढ.प्रसृतम् उदक.मार्गं प्रस्रवण.प्रपातं वा कारयेत्
lines_iast: tripadī.pratikrāntam adhyardham aratniṃ vā gāḍha.prasṛtam udaka.mārgaṃ prasravaṇa.prapātaṃ vā kārayet

hindi: उसका अतिक्रमण होने पर चौवन पण का दण्ड है।
english: In transgression of that, the penalty is [one] of fifty-four paṇas.
notes: catuṣ-pañcāśat is read as 'four plus fifty', i.e. 54. paṇa stays a unit name.

hindi: एक पद पीछे हटा हुआ अथवा एक अरत्नि, पहियेवालों और चौपायों का स्थान, अग्निष्ठ, उदन्-जर का स्थान, रोचनी अथवा कुट्टनी बनवाए।
english: Receded by one step or by one aratni, [one] should have made a place for the wheeled and the four-footed, an agniṣṭha (literally 'standing in fire'), an udan-jara place, a rocanī or a kuṭṭanī.
notes: Several obscure words kept as printed: udan-jara, rocanī, kuṭṭanī. cakri taken as 'one with a wheel' (cakrin); catuṣpada 'four-footed'. agniṣṭha: literally 'standing in fire', rendered 'fireplace' tentatively. kuṭṭanī is from √kuṭṭ 'pound'; in Hindi कुट्टनी has an unrelated common sense (procuress) which is not meant here. Whether 'receded' applies to all the items is not settled.
lines_deva: एकपदी.प्रतिक्रान्तम् अरत्निं वा चक्रि.चतुष्पद.स्थानम् अग्निष्ठम् उदन्.जर.स्थानं रोचनीं कुट्टनीं वा कारयेत्
lines_iast: ekapadī.pratikrāntam aratniṃ vā cakri.catuṣpada.sthānam agniṣṭham udan.jara.sthānaṃ rocanīṃ kuṭṭanīṃ vā kārayet

hindi: उसका अतिक्रमण होने पर चौबीस पण का दण्ड है।
english: In transgression of that, the penalty is [one] of twenty-four paṇas.

hindi: सर्व-वास्तुक अथवा प्राक्षिप्तक दो शालाओं की अन्तरिका किष्कु अथवा तीन पद है।
english: Of two halls, [whether] of the whole-site kind (sarva-vāstuka) or of the prākṣiptaka kind, the interval [is] a kiṣku, or three steps.
notes: sarva-vāstuka (literally 'of the whole site') and prākṣiptaka (literally 'thrown in/forward'; possibly pra-ākṣipta) are obscure and left near-literal. kiṣku is a measure of length, kept. kiṣkuḥ antarikā tripadī vā is taken as apposition: the interval is a kiṣku or three steps. vā after prākṣiptakayoḥ joins the two kinds of hall.
lines_deva: सर्व.वास्तुकयोः प्राक्षिप्तकयोर् वा शालयोः किष्कुर् अन्तरिका त्रिपदी वा
lines_iast: sarva.vāstukayoḥ prākṣiptakayor vā śālayoḥ kiṣkur antarikā tripadī vā

hindi: उन दोनों का चार अङ्गुल का नीप्र-अन्तर अथवा समारूढक।
english: Of those two, a nīpra-interval of four finger-breadths, or a samārūḍhaka.

text_flags.why: possible: the editors' own doubt mark offers this variant; not applied

notes: nīpra is obscure; the editors offer the doubtful variant nīvra (not applied). Neither is given a sense here (a roof-edge or eaves sense is possible but not stated). samārūḍhaka: literally 'mounted together, overlapping'; kept as printed. Predicate not stated. The variant token is listed as the same word, not an additional item.

words.gloss: of the measure of a kiṣku
for the sake of the broken and burst-open

hindi: अन्तरिका में किष्कु-मात्र का आणि-द्वार, खण्ड-फुल्ल के प्रयोजन से, असम्पात बनवाए।
english: [One] should have made, in the interval, a door with an āṇi, of the measure of a kiṣku, for the sake of the broken and the burst-open, without sampāta.
notes: āṇi is rendered 'peg/pin' tentatively; āṇi-dvāra is obscure (a peg-fastened or small door). khaṇḍa-phulla: literally 'broken, burst-open'; the word 'repair' is not in the text and is not supplied. asampāta: sampāta 'falling together, passage'; the sense is not settled (possibly 'without a passage through'); kept as printed.
lines_deva: किष्कु.मात्रम् आणि.द्वारम् अन्तरिकायां खण्ड.फुल्ल.अर्थम् असम्पातं कारयेत्
lines_iast: kiṣku.mātram āṇi.dvāram antarikāyāṃ khaṇḍa.phulla.artham asampātaṃ kārayet

hindi: प्रकाश के प्रयोजन से ऊपर छोटा वातायन बनवाए।
english: [One] should have made, for the sake of light, a small air-passage (vāta-ayana) above.
notes: vāta-ayana: literally 'wind-passage' (Hindi वातायन, the same word).

hindi: उसके पूरा होने पर घर में ढके।
english: When that is finished, [one] should cover [it] in the house.
notes: The token veśmanic-chādayet is veśmani + chādayet with the regular c-insertion before ch. The object of chādayet is not stated (veśmani is a locative). 'Cover' is literal (√chad); 'roof' is a likely sense but not stated.

hindi: अथवा घर के स्वामी मिलकर जैसा इष्ट हो वैसा करवाएँ, अनिष्ट को रोकें।
english: Or the house-owners, having come together, should have [it] done as desired; they should prevent what is undesired.
notes: The object of kārayeyuḥ is not stated ('it' supplied). vārayeyuḥ is a causative form with ordinary sense 'keep off, prevent'.
lines_deva: सम्भूय वा गृह.स्वामिनो यथा.इष्टं कारयेयुः, अनिष्टं वारयेयुः
lines_iast: sambhūya vā gṛha.svāmino yathā.iṣṭaṃ kārayeyuḥ, aniṣṭaṃ vārayeyuḥ

hindi: तथा वान-लटी के ऊपर ढकने योग्य भाग, चटाई से ढका हुआ, अथवा अवमर्श-भित्ति वर्षा की बाधा के भय से बनवाए।
english: And above the vāna-laṭī, [one] should have made a part to be screened, covered with a mat, or an avamarśa-wall, from fear of trouble from rain.
notes: vāna-laṭī and avamarśa-bhitti are obscure and kept as printed. The accusatives 'āvārya-bhāgam kaṭa-pracchannam' (a screenable part covered with a mat) and 'avamarśa-bhittim' are the two alternatives joined by vā. kaṭa: mat. ābādha: trouble, obstruction. The genitive plus ūrdhvam is read 'above the ...'.
lines_deva: वान.लट्याश् च-ऊर्ध्वम् आवार्य.भागं कट.प्रच्छन्नम् अवमर्श.भित्तिं वा कारयेद् वर्ष.आबाध.भयात्
lines_iast: vāna.laṭyāś ca-ūrdhvam āvārya.bhāgaṃ kaṭa.pracchannam avamarśa.bhittiṃ vā kārayed varṣa.ābādha.bhayāt

words.gloss: in obstruction by contrary doors, air-passages

hindi: उसका अतिक्रमण होने पर प्रथम साहस-दण्ड है, और प्रतिलोम द्वार-वातायन की बाधा में, राजमार्ग और रथ्याओं को छोड़कर।
english: In transgression of that, [there is] the first fine for rashness; and in the obstruction [caused by] contrary doors and air-passages; except [as regards] royal roads and streets.
notes: pratiloma: 'against the grain, reversed, contrary'; here probably doors and air-passages facing the wrong way, but only the literal word is given. bādhā: obstruction; whether the doors obstruct or are obstructed is not settled. rathyā: street, carriage-road. The unit after the first clause has no further verb; the fine of the first clause is carried over.
lines_deva: तस्य-अतिक्रमे पूर्वः साहस.दण्डः, प्रतिलोम.द्वार.वात.अयन.बाधायां च, अन्यत्र राज.मार्ग.रथ्याभ्यः
lines_iast: tasya-atikrame pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ, pratiloma.dvāra.vāta.ayana.bādhāyāṃ ca, anyatra rāja.mārga.rathyābhyaḥ

words.gloss: by portions of pit, steps, drain, ladder, refuse

hindi: खात-सोपान-प्रणाली-निःश्रेणी-अवस्कर के भागों द्वारा बाहर की बाधा में तथा उपभोग के निग्रह में।
english: By portions of a pit, steps, a drain, a ladder and refuse, in obstruction outside and in restraint of use —
notes: Fragment with no predicate; it continues the fine of unit 20 (not a GROUPING error, the edition numbers it separately). khāta: excavation, pit; sopāna: steps, stairs; niśreṇī: ladder; bhāga: portion, part. The e-text niśreṇy.avaskara carries a regular y-sandhi.

words.gram: pres. part. upa-√han m. gen. sg.

words.gloss: in damage by urine and excrement

hindi: दूसरे की दीवार को जल से हानि पहुँचाने वाले का बारह पण का दण्ड है; मूत्र-पुरीष से हानि होने पर दुगुना।
english: For one who damages another's wall with water, the penalty is twelve paṇas; in damage by urine and excrement, double.
notes: upa-√han is rendered 'damage' (literally 'strike at, injure'). In the second clause the predicate 'is' is not stated; dvi-guṇaḥ is taken as 'double' (the penalty).
lines_deva: पर.कुड्यम् उदकेन-उपघ्नतो द्वादश.पणो दण्डः, मूत्र.पुरीष.उपघाते द्वि.गुणः
lines_iast: para.kuḍyam udakena-upaghnato dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, mūtra.purīṣa.upaghāte dvi.guṇaḥ

hindi: प्रणाली का छोड़ना वर्षा होने पर है; अन्यथा बारह पण का दण्ड है।
english: The release of the drain [is] when it rains; otherwise, the penalty is twelve paṇas.
notes: varṣati may be a locative absolute ('when it rains') or a 3 sg. present ('it rains'); the sense is the same. praṇālī: water-channel, drain, spout. Whether this is a permission or an instruction is not stated.

words.gram: pres. part. nir-√as m. gen. sg.

words.gloss: from harshness, theft, rashness, seizure, wrongful use

hindi: तथा निषेध किए जाने पर रहने वाले का, तथा किराये वाले को निकालने वाले का, पारुष्य, स्तेय, साहस, सङ्ग्रहण, मिथ्या-भोग को छोड़कर।
english: And of one who dwells [though] forbidden, and of one who casts out the avakrayin (one on hire), except [in cases of] harshness, theft, rashness, seizure and wrongful use.
notes: Fragment without a predicate; no fine is stated in this unit (the fine of unit 23 is not repeated). avakrayin: one who has [a property] on hire (tenant), literal; the other direction (one who lets) is possible. pāruṣya is not specified (speech or physical); saṅgrahaṇa: seizing, holding. mithyā-bhoga: wrongful use.
lines_deva: प्रतिषिद्धस्य च वसतः, निरस्यतश् च-अवक्रयिणम् अन्यत्र पारुष्य.स्तेय.साहस.सङ्ग्रहण.मिथ्या.भोगेभ्यः
lines_iast: pratiṣiddhasya ca vasataḥ, nirasyataś ca-avakrayiṇam anyatra pāruṣya.steya.sāhasa.saṅgrahaṇa.mithyā.bhogebhyaḥ

hindi: स्वयं प्रस्थान करने वाला वर्ष के किराये का शेष दे।
english: One who has departed of his own accord should give the remainder of the year's hire.

text_flags.why: ṃ before a vowel inside the compound; regular form would be svayam (possible)

notes: varṣa is taken as 'year'; 'rainy season' is possible. avakraya: hire (glossary 4.1). The compound svayam-abhiprasthita is written svayaṃ.abhiprasthito in the e-text (anusvāra before the dot). Possible typo (hand edit): 'svayaṃ.abhiprasthito' has ṃ before a vowel inside the compound; regular form would be svayam-abhiprasthitaḥ. Not applied.

words.gram: pres. part. a-pra-√yam m. gen. sg.
pres. part. upa-√rudh m. gen. sg.

hindi: साझे घर में सहायता न देने वाले का, साझे तथा उपभोग को घर में रोकने वाले का, बारह पण का दण्ड है।
english: Of one who gives no assistance in a common house, of one who obstructs the common [thing] and the use in the house, [there is] a penalty of twelve paṇas.
notes: sāmānyam bhogam ca may also be read 'the common use' (sāmānyam as adjective of bhogam); the literal sequence is followed. sāmānya: common, shared.
lines_deva: सामान्ये वेश्मनि साहाय्यम् अप्रयच्छतः, सामान्यम् उपरुन्धतो भोगं च गृहे द्वादश.पणो दण्डः
lines_iast: sāmānye veśmani sāhāyyam aprayacchataḥ, sāmānyam uparundhato bhogaṃ ca gṛhe dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ

words.gram: pres. part. caus. vi-√naś m. gen. sg.

hindi: नष्ट करने वाले का उसका दुगुना है।
english: Of one who destroys, [the penalty is] double that.
notes: The object of the destruction is not stated; 'that' is the penalty of unit 26.

hindi: कोष्ठक, आँगन, वर्च के; अग्नि-कुट्टन-शालाओं के, तथा सब खुले हुओं के उपभोग को साझा माना जाता है।
english: Of storerooms, courtyards and privies, of the fire-hall and the pounding-hall, and of all open ones, the use is held to be common.
notes: varca (the printed -varcānām) is taken as 'privy' (literally 'excrement'); the stem varca for varcas is unusual but may be a compound-final form. agni-kuṭṭana-śālayoḥ is read as two halls, a fire-hall and a pounding-hall; a dual of the compound is the only support. vivṛta: open, uncovered. Metre: two 16-syllable lines, regular anuṣṭubh, with the e-text's resolved sandhi (koṣṭhaka.aṅgaṇa read koṣṭhakāṅgaṇa).
lines_deva: विवृतानां च सर्वेषां सामान्यो भोग इष्यते
lines_iast: vivṛtānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ sāmānyo bhoga iṣyate
